title: Chocolate has to be taught how to set

sentences.text: Good chocolate snaps when you break it.
It is glossy. It melts in the mouth
sentences.translationRu: Он глянцевый. Он тает во рту

sentences.text: and not in your hand.
Melt it and let it cool
and you get none of that.
sentences.translationRu: и не получишь ничего из этого.

sentences.text: Soft, dull, with pale streaks.
Same chocolate. Same ingredients.
sentences.translationRu: Тот же шоколад. Те же ингредиенты.

sentences.text: The difference is the shape of the fat.
Cocoa butter can set in several ways.
Six of them, arranged differently.
The molecules are identical in each.
Only the packing differs.
And the packing decides everything.
Five of the six are bad.
They melt too low, look dull,
sentences.translationRu: Они плавятся слишком рано, выглядят тускло,

sentences.text: and break softly rather than snapping.
sentences.translationRu: и ломаются мягко, а не щёлкают.

sentences.text: One of them is what everybody wants.
sentences.translationRu: И только одна — то, чего все хотят.

sentences.text: It is called form five.
It melts at around thirty-four degrees.
sentences.translationRu: Она плавится примерно при тридцати четырёх градусах.

sentences.text: Which is just below body temperature.
Hence melting in the mouth and not the hand.
sentences.translationRu: Отсюда и таяние во рту, а не в руке.

sentences.text: Left alone, chocolate does not choose it.
sentences.translationRu: Сам по себе шоколад её не выбирает.

sentences.text: It sets into whichever form starts first.
sentences.translationRu: Он застывает в ту форму, которая началась первой.

sentences.text: And the bad ones start more easily.
So the crystals have to be planted.
That is what tempering is.
Heat the chocolate until every form melts.
sentences.translationRu: Нагрей шоколад, пока не растают все формы.

sentences.text: Around fifty degrees. A blank slate.
Then cool it too far, to around twenty-seven.
sentences.translationRu: Потом остуди с запасом, примерно до двадцати семи.

sentences.text: Now several forms begin to crystallise.
Including the one you want.
Then warm it slightly, to about thirty-one.
sentences.translationRu: Потом чуть подогрей, примерно до тридцати одного.

sentences.text: The unwanted crystals melt again.
Form five does not. It melts higher.
So the chocolate is now seeded
with only the crystals you wanted.
Everything that sets after this copies them.
sentences.translationRu: Всё, что застывает дальше, копирует их.

sentences.text: Which is why untempered chocolate
develops pale streaks after a few days.
The fat is slowly rearranging
into the form it preferred all along.
sentences.translationRu: в ту форму, которую предпочитал с самого начала.

sentences.text: It is still edible. It has simply given up.

title: Working with a material that never stops moving

sentences.text: Molten glass is not like molten metal.
sentences.translationRu: Расплавленное стекло не похоже на расплавленный металл.

sentences.text: Metal is liquid and then it is solid.
There is a line, and it is crossed.
Glass has no such line.
It thickens gradually as it cools.
From something like honey
to something like cold toffee
to something that will not move at all.
sentences.translationRu: а потом до того, что вовсе не движется.

sentences.text: Which means the material is a clock.
Every second it is a different substance.
A glassblower is not shaping glass.
They are working inside a narrow window
that is closing while they work.
The gather comes out of the furnace
at well over a thousand degrees.
It is glowing and it is soft.
And it is trying to fall off the pipe.
So the pipe must turn, constantly.
Gravity is pulling the shape down
the entire time it is being made.
Turning spreads that pull evenly around.
Stop turning for two seconds
and the piece is ruined.
This is why the work looks like dancing.
The turning is not style.
It is the only thing holding the shape.
Heat has to be managed in the same way.
sentences.translationRu: Так же приходится управлять и температурой.

sentences.text: A piece cools from the outside.
So the surface stiffens while the middle flows.
sentences.translationRu: Поверхность твердеет, пока середина ещё течёт.

sentences.text: Work it too long and it cracks.
sentences.translationRu: Работай слишком долго — и оно треснет.

sentences.text: So it goes back to a reheating chamber.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому его возвращают в разогревочную камеру.

sentences.text: Every minute or two, all the way through.
The last stage is the one nobody sees.
A finished piece cannot simply cool.
It would break within hours.
Outside and inside cool at different rates,
sentences.translationRu: Наружное и внутреннее остывают с разной скоростью,

sentences.text: and the difference builds stress inside the glass.
sentences.translationRu: и разница копит напряжение внутри стекла.

sentences.text: So it goes into an oven
that is slowly turned down over many hours.
Sometimes days, for something thick.
The making takes twenty minutes.
The cooling takes a night.
And the cooling is where most pieces are lost.
sentences.translationRu: И именно на остывании теряется большинство изделий.

title: Salt does not only make food salty

sentences.text: Salt is described as one of five tastes.
sentences.translationRu: Соль описывают как один из пяти вкусов.

sentences.text: Which is true and badly incomplete.
If salt only added saltiness,
sentences.translationRu: Если бы соль только добавляла солёность,

sentences.text: undersalted food would taste like itself,
only less salty.
It does not. It tastes flat.
sentences.translationRu: Это не так. Она на вкус плоская.

sentences.text: Which is a different complaint entirely.
Salt does at least three separate things.
sentences.translationRu: Соль делает как минимум три разные вещи.

sentences.text: The first is suppression.
Salt reduces the perception of bitterness.
Substantially, and at low concentrations.
Most ingredients contain some bitterness.
sentences.translationRu: В большинстве продуктов есть немного горечи.

sentences.text: Usually unnoticed, sitting under everything.
sentences.translationRu: Обычно незаметной, лежащей под всем остальным.

sentences.text: Remove some of it and what remains
sentences.translationRu: Убери её часть — и то, что останется,

sentences.text: appears to have grown.
Sweetness comes forward. So does sourness.
Nothing was added except one thing removed.
sentences.translationRu: Ничего не добавили — только одно убрали.

sentences.text: This is why salt in a dessert works.
Salted caramel is not a novelty.
It is caramel with the bitterness turned down.
The second thing is release.
Many aroma compounds are held
in the water in a dish.
Dissolved salt changes how water behaves
towards those compounds.
It pushes some of them out of the liquid
sentences.translationRu: Она выталкивает часть из них из жидкости

sentences.text: and into the air above it.
Where your nose is.
Salt makes a dish smell of more.
sentences.translationRu: Соль делает так, что блюдо пахнет сильнее.

sentences.text: And most of taste is smell.
sentences.translationRu: А вкус — это по большей части запах.

sentences.text: The third is timing, and cooks argue about it.
sentences.translationRu: Третье — время, и повара об этом спорят.

sentences.text: Salt added early has time to move.
It enters the food rather than sitting on it.
sentences.translationRu: Она входит в продукт, а не лежит на нём.

sentences.text: Salt added at the end sits on the surface
sentences.translationRu: Соль в конце остаётся на поверхности

sentences.text: and arrives in a sharper burst.
Neither is wrong. They are different effects.
sentences.translationRu: Ни то ни другое не ошибка. Это разные эффекты.

sentences.text: Which explains an ordinary kitchen experience.
A dish that tastes of nothing
is often not missing an ingredient.
It is missing the thing that lets
sentences.translationRu: Ему не хватает того, что позволяет

sentences.text: the ingredients already in it be noticed.
sentences.translationRu: заметить то, что в нём уже есть.

title: Why so many borders are perfectly straight

sentences.text: Look at a map of Africa.
Or of the western United States.
A great many borders are straight lines.
Some run for hundreds of kilometres
without bending once.
No river is straight. No mountain range is.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одна река не прямая. Ни один хребет.

sentences.text: No language boundary is either.
So a straight border means something specific.
It was drawn by people
who were not standing on the land.
sentences.translationRu: которые на этой земле не стояли.

sentences.text: The African case is the clearest.
Most of that map was fixed
in a period of about twenty years
at the end of the nineteenth century.
European powers were dividing territory
they had largely not surveyed.
sentences.translationRu: которую по большей части не обследовали.

sentences.text: Agreements were reached in European rooms.
Lines were specified by latitude and longitude
because that was information everybody had.
sentences.translationRu: потому что эти сведения были у всех.

sentences.text: What nobody had was knowledge
sentences.translationRu: Чего не было ни у кого — так это знания

sentences.text: of who lived where.
The consequences are not abstract.
A straight line does not ask
whether it is cutting a group in half.
sentences.translationRu: не разрезает ли она надвое какой-то народ.

sentences.text: Estimates suggest a large share
of African ethnic groups are split
across at least one border.
Research has found measurable effects
that persist to the present day.
Partitioned groups show more conflict
and worse provision of public services.
Which is not a claim about the people.
sentences.translationRu: И это утверждение не о людях.

sentences.text: It is a claim about administering a community
through two separate states.
There is a reasonable question in response.
Would redrawing them help?
The near-universal answer among African states
has been no.
An early agreement committed them
to keep the borders they inherited.
Not because the lines are good.
Because the alternative is every border
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что альтернатива — каждая граница

sentences.text: becoming negotiable at the same moment.
sentences.translationRu: становится предметом торга в один и тот же момент.

sentences.text: A bad map that everyone accepts
can be more stable than a better one
that has to be agreed first.

title: A song that crossed an ocean

sentences.text: Male humpback whales sing.
Long, structured sequences
repeated for hours at a time.
The remarkable part is not the singing.
It is that every male in a population
sentences.translationRu: А то, что каждый самец в популяции

sentences.text: sings very nearly the same song.
sentences.translationRu: поёт почти одну и ту же песню.

sentences.text: Not an inherited song. A current one.
It changes through the season
and every singer changes with it.
sentences.translationRu: и каждый певец меняется вместе с ней.

sentences.text: Within weeks the whole group has updated.
This is already unusual.
Then researchers tracking whales
across the Pacific found something else.
sentences.translationRu: через Тихий океан, нашли ещё кое-что.

sentences.text: A song from one population off Australia
appeared the following year
in a population thousands of kilometres east.
sentences.translationRu: у популяции за тысячи километров к востоку.

sentences.text: Then the year after, further east again.
It moved across the ocean
in one direction, in steps,
over several years.
And it displaced the local song entirely.
Not blended with it. Replaced it.
The word researchers use is culture.
Which is used carefully and defended.
The technical sense is narrow.
Behaviour transmitted by learning
rather than by genes,
varying between groups,
and changing over time.
Whale song meets all three.
It is not the only case.
Some chimpanzee groups use tools
that neighbouring groups do not,
with the same food available.
Some bird populations have local dialects.
sentences.translationRu: У части популяций птиц есть местные диалекты.

sentences.text: What the whales add is scale and speed.
A cultural change moving across an ocean basin
sentences.translationRu: Культурное изменение, идущее через океанский бассейн

sentences.text: in a few years is not a small thing.
The open question is why it travels one way.
sentences.translationRu: Открытый вопрос — почему она идёт в одну сторону.

sentences.text: The leading suggestion is simply numbers.
The songs move from larger populations
sentences.translationRu: Песни идут от более крупных популяций

sentences.text: towards smaller ones.
Which, if it holds, would make whale song
sentences.translationRu: Что, если подтвердится, сделало бы песню кита

sentences.text: a fashion travelling in the ordinary way.
From wherever the most voices are.

title: The immune system is not an army

sentences.text: The immune system is almost always
explained with military language.
Defences. Invaders. Attack. Battle.
The metaphor is old and it is useful
and it gets several things badly wrong.
sentences.translationRu: и в нескольких вещах серьёзно ошибается.

sentences.text: An army defends a border
against things that come from outside.
Most of what your immune system handles
sentences.translationRu: Бóльшая часть того, чем занимается иммунная система,

sentences.text: is not outside and not an enemy.
You carry an enormous population of bacteria.
Comparable in number to your own cells.
sentences.translationRu: Сопоставимую по числу с твоими клетками.

sentences.text: Most of them are necessary.
The immune system does not fail to notice them.
It actively maintains them.
It shapes which species live where,
sentences.translationRu: Она определяет, какие виды где живут,

sentences.text: suppresses some, tolerates others,
and negotiates continuously.
Gardening is a closer metaphor than war.
sentences.translationRu: Садоводство ближе как метафора, чем война.

sentences.text: The second failure is about tolerance.
A military system's hardest problem
is finding the enemy.
An immune system's hardest problem
is not attacking you.
It must recognise an unlimited variety
of things it has never encountered,
sentences.translationRu: того, с чем никогда не встречалась,

sentences.text: while never reacting to the trillions of cells
sentences.translationRu: и при этом никогда не реагировать на триллионы клеток,

sentences.text: that are legitimately yours.
Most of its training is spent on the second.
sentences.translationRu: Бóльшая часть её обучения уходит на второе.

sentences.text: Cells that react to your own body
are destroyed during development
in enormous numbers.
Restraint, not aggression, is the achievement.
sentences.translationRu: Достижение здесь — сдержанность, а не агрессия.

sentences.text: The third failure is where the metaphor
does the most damage.
It suggests that more is better.
A stronger immune system, boosted.
The word appears on a great many products.
But a large share of immune disease
is the system doing too much.
sentences.translationRu: — это система, которая делает слишком много.

sentences.text: Allergy is a response out of proportion.
Autoimmunity is a response aimed inwards.
Serious infections often kill
through the reaction rather than the organism.
You would not describe that as weak.
The thing you want is not a stronger system.
It is a better calibrated one.
Which nothing on a shelf can sell you.
sentences.translationRu: А это не продаётся ни на одной полке.

title: Somebody decides what the future will have

sentences.text: An archive is usually imagined
as a place where things are kept.
It is more accurately a place
where almost everything is thrown away.
A large organisation generates
an unmanageable volume of records.
Keeping all of it is not an option.
Not for reasons of space alone.
An archive where everything is kept
is one where nothing can be found.
sentences.translationRu: — это архив, где ничего не найти.

sentences.text: So an archivist selects.
Typically a few per cent survives.
Which makes the selection the profession.
sentences.translationRu: И именно отбор и составляет профессию.

sentences.text: Not the shelving. The choosing.
The difficulty is that value
is being judged in advance
for people who have not been born,
sentences.translationRu: для людей, которые ещё не родились,

sentences.text: asking questions nobody has thought of.
sentences.translationRu: и вопросов, которых никто не придумал.

sentences.text: Historians have a standard complaint
about earlier generations of archivists.
They kept the correspondence of important men
and discarded the records of ordinary work.
Wage books, admission registers, complaints.
Which turned out to be
what later historians most wanted.
sentences.translationRu: тем, чего позднейшие историки хотели больше всего.

sentences.text: The lesson was learned
and it did not solve the problem.
It only moved it.
Current archivists are aware
that they are making the same kind of guess
sentences.translationRu: что делают догадку того же рода,

sentences.text: with different assumptions.
Digital records changed the shape of this.
Storage became cheap enough
that keeping everything is now possible.
Which did not remove the decision.
It moved it to the search.
What can be found is what has been indexed.
And indexing is selection
wearing different clothes.
There is also a new fragility.
Paper neglected for a century is readable.
A file neglected for twenty years
may have no software left to open it.
sentences.translationRu: может остаться без программы, которая его откроет.

sentences.text: So the durable format is the fragile one
sentences.translationRu: Так что долговечный формат оказывается хрупким,

sentences.text: and the fragile one turned out to last.

title: A coral is two organisms, and one of them leaves

sentences.text: A coral looks like a rock or a plant.
sentences.translationRu: Коралл выглядит как камень или растение.

sentences.text: It is an animal, and not only one.
A coral polyp is a small creature
related to a jellyfish.
Inside its tissue live algae.
Enormous numbers of them, in every cell.
sentences.translationRu: В огромном количестве, в каждой клетке.

sentences.text: The arrangement is a trade.
The algae photosynthesise
and hand over most of what they make.
Up to ninety per cent of the coral's energy
comes from a tenant it is housing.
sentences.translationRu: приходит от жильца, которого он селит.

sentences.text: In exchange the algae get shelter
and a supply of nitrogen.
This is why reefs exist where they do.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому рифы и стоят там, где стоят.

sentences.text: Tropical water is famously poor in nutrients.
sentences.translationRu: Тропическая вода славится бедностью питательными веществами.

sentences.text: A reef is a dense city of life
in what is close to a desert.
It works because the partnership
recycles almost everything internally.
The algae are also the colour.
The polyp itself is nearly transparent.
Under it is white skeleton.
So the colour of a reef
is the colour of its tenants.
Now raise the temperature.
Around one degree above the usual summer maximum
sentences.translationRu: Примерно на градус выше обычного летнего максимума

sentences.text: is enough, if it is sustained.
The algae's photosynthesis goes wrong.
It starts producing damaging by-products
sentences.translationRu: Он начинает давать повреждающие побочные продукты

sentences.text: faster than either partner can clear them.
sentences.translationRu: быстрее, чем оба партнёра успевают их убирать.

sentences.text: The coral expels them.
This is bleaching.
The white is not death.
It is the skeleton showing through
a transparent and now starving animal.
sentences.translationRu: сквозь прозрачное и теперь голодающее животное.

sentences.text: Which is the part most reports skip.
A bleached coral is alive.
If the water cools within weeks,
algae can be taken back in.
The coral recovers, weakened.
If it does not cool, it starves.
sentences.translationRu: Если не остынет — он умирает от голода.

sentences.text: So the number that matters is not temperature.
It is how long the temperature stays.
And the interval between events.
A reef can survive a bad year.
What it cannot survive is bad years
sentences.translationRu: Чего он не переживает — это плохие годы,

sentences.text: arriving faster than it can rebuild.
sentences.translationRu: приходящие быстрее, чем он успевает отстроиться.

title: A computer cannot produce a random number

sentences.text: Ask a computer for a random number
and it will give you one.
It is not random.
It cannot be, and the reason is definitional.
sentences.translationRu: Не может быть, и причина определительная.

sentences.text: A computer is a machine
that produces the same output
from the same input, every time.
sentences.translationRu: из того же входа, каждый раз.

sentences.text: That property is the entire point of it.
sentences.translationRu: Это свойство и есть весь его смысл.

sentences.text: A machine that did otherwise
sentences.translationRu: Машина, которая вела бы себя иначе,

sentences.text: would be described as broken.
So what it produces is a sequence
sentences.translationRu: Значит, то, что он выдаёт, — это последовательность,

sentences.text: that looks random to anyone
who does not know how it was made.
sentences.translationRu: кто не знает, как она получена.

sentences.text: The term used is pseudorandom,
and the prefix is doing real work.
It starts from a seed, a starting number.
sentences.translationRu: Она стартует от зерна, начального числа.

sentences.text: The same seed gives the same sequence.
sentences.translationRu: То же зерно даёт ту же последовательность.

sentences.text: For most purposes this is fine
and is occasionally an advantage.
A simulation that can be rerun exactly
is easier to debug than one that cannot.
sentences.translationRu: отлаживается легче, чем та, которую нельзя.

sentences.text: It stops being fine for security.
A key generated from a predictable sequence
is a key somebody can regenerate.
sentences.translationRu: — это ключ, который кто-то может воспроизвести.

sentences.text: There have been real failures of exactly this kind.
sentences.translationRu: Реальные провалы ровно такого рода бывали.

sentences.text: Systems seeded from the clock,
which narrows the search to a few million values.
sentences.translationRu: что сужает перебор до нескольких миллионов значений.

sentences.text: So real randomness has to come from outside.
sentences.translationRu: Поэтому настоящая случайность должна приходить извне.

sentences.text: Operating systems collect it constantly.
The precise timing of keystrokes.
Small variations in disk and network timing.
sentences.translationRu: Мелкие вариации в таймингах диска и сети.

sentences.text: Electrical noise in a sensor.
None of these is random in itself.
sentences.translationRu: Ничто из этого само по себе не случайно.

sentences.text: Each is merely too complicated to predict.
Which is a weaker claim and sufficient.
For the strongest requirements
some systems use quantum sources,
where unpredictability is not
a limit of our knowledge
but a property of the physics.
There is something worth sitting with here.
To get one genuinely unpredictable number,
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы получить одно по-настоящему непредсказуемое число,

sentences.text: a machine built entirely for predictability
has to go outside and ask the world.
sentences.translationRu: должна выйти наружу и спросить мир.
